title: Unavailable entity
responsibility: Explains why an entity cannot be shown and offers a return destination.

inputs.name: EntityMissing.title
inputs.description: Heading text, always rendered as the content of the hx-h1 whose id is ex-missing-title, which is the id the Card receives as labelledby. It is rendered as given, with no validation or trimming.
examples: Report not available at this revision

inputs.name: EntityMissing.message
inputs.description: Explanation of why nothing is shown, always rendered as the lead paragraph (hx-p, class ex-lead) directly under the heading. It is rendered as given with no validation, and a fixed paragraph (hx-p, class ex-soft) follows it stating that nothing from another revision is shown in its place.
examples: The entity does not exist at the selected revision.
This report has no entry at the selected revision, so there is nothing to show.

inputs.name: EntityMissing.nav
inputs.description: Navigation helper for the return link: nav.href(to) supplies the href passed to the HarnessAction, and nav.go(to) runs when that link is clicked. The component uses no other member of it and performs no check on it.

inputs.name: EntityMissing.to
inputs.description: Destination passed unchanged to nav.href(to), which supplies the link's href, and to nav.go(to), which runs on click. The component never reads its fields.

inputs.name: EntityMissing.action
inputs.description: Text of the return link, passed as the HarnessAction's content. When omitted or undefined it is 'Back to the collection', and it is rendered as given with no validation.

outputs.name: EntityMissing
outputs.description: Renders a section Card (tone ex-missing, labelledby ex-missing-title) that holds the title as an hx-h1, the message as an hx-p with class ex-lead, the fixed sentence 'Nothing from another revision is shown in its place.' as an hx-p with class ex-soft, and a HarnessAction with the arrow-left lead. The HarnessAction's href is nav.href(to), its click runs nav.go(to), and its label is action.
